sloka: तव मातुरसद्ग्राहम् विद्मः पूर्वम् यथाश्रुतम् ।पितुस्ते वरदः कश्चिद्ददौ वरमनुत्तमम् ॥२-३५-१८॥
transliteration: tava māturasadgrāham vidmaḥ pūrvam yathāśrutam ।pituste varadaḥ kaściddadau varamanuttamam ॥2-35-18॥

translations.english: We have heard in the past about the evil (stubborn) nature of your mother. Once a bestower of boons conferred an extraordinary boon on your father by virtue of which he could tell the sounds of all living beings. He also understood the language of all crookedly moving creatures.
translations.hindi: PS 0 १ शाचिः- -श्रकुट्लः । ( गो० ) तब सिद्धाथे नामक प्रधान मंत्री ने, जो कुटिल न था और जिसे महाराज दशरथ बहुत चाहते थे, कैकेयी से कहा
